I had a wonderful childhood in San Diego where it rains about two days a year, and it's always sunny and bright. I could ride my bike any day of the year, and had lots of friends. My best friend was George Kenny. He lived just a few houses down the block from me, and we were the same age.

I thought about forming a bicycle club with him one day. "Why not?" he said. We started it as the White Skulls because they would make a great symbol for our club.

We each picked a skull decal to put on our bikes: green for George Kenny and red for myself, who was more of an older kid. I chose a green one, and he screamed "I am the king! I am the best!" to stop me from taking it back.

George was tall, but no one argued with him. We rode our bikes everywhere during our summer and had great fun. That's how we formed the greatest bike club ever!
